propositions: A locked dirty tracker must be staged and committed under a write lock before delegating to push_tickets_branch, preserving uncommitted inbound events and bridge-bot authorship.

Before staging or committing, the entrypoint must check for rebase/merge-recovery state using lock.check_no_rebase_in_progress; strict mode raises PushDeliveryError with merge-recovery-blocked, default mode warns and returns without staging or pushing.

The entrypoint must accept optional author_name and author_email parameters and apply them per-commit using git -c flags without mutating global or repository config; ambient identity is used when omitted.
Clean but locally-ahead trees must be pushed without creating empty commits; persistent rejection under strict mode raises PushDeliveryError while preserving the local commit, not returning success.

Lock, staging, and commit failures must raise dependency-defined PushDeliveryError with stable reasons (commit-lock-timeout, stage-failed, commit-failed) in strict mode; default mode warns, returns, and retains content for later retry.
The push_tickets_branch primitive must remain push-only and never stage or commit a dirty tracker.
